Wangari Preface Gift Set Hamper – Premium Eco-Friendly Corporate Gifting Solution

The Wangari Preface Gift Set Hamper is a thoughtfully curated premium gifting solution designed for modern corporate, festive, and executive gifting needs. Crafted with sustainability, elegance, and utility in mind, this exclusive hamper reflects the essence of responsible luxury. With a sleek black box packaging, refined aesthetics, and practical daily-use products, it is ideal for employee appreciation, client gifting, festive celebrations, onboarding kits, and brand promotions.

This For Gifting combines innovation, eco-conscious materials, and premium finishes, making it a standout choice in the corporate gifting category. Every product in this is carefully selected to enhance brand value while delivering real utility to the recipient.

What’s Inside

  • Wangari Willow 15W Wireless Charger With Cup Warmer – A multifunctional desktop essential that supports fast wireless charging and keeps beverages warm, enhancing productivity at workstations.

  • Wangari Custom Table Top Calendar– A practical and customizable desk calendar perfect for branding and year-round visibility.
  • Wangari Eco Friendly Diary featuring black denim and cork texture with flap clip – A sustainable, stylish notebook ideal for professionals, meetings, and planning.
